corrections.critique: Strongest feature: Hawkins directly answers the regulative-or-real challenge by presenting inquiry as an experientially integrated relationship in which knower and known reciprocally interact, thereby explaining why understanding can intelligibly possess direction rather than confront an intrinsically inaccessible reality. Principal limitation: The argument insufficiently differentiates epistemic interaction, metaphysical unity, progressive intelligibility, and actual attainability, so movement toward improved understanding does not distinctively establish Bradleyan idealism or a completed absolute. Live burden: Hawkins must demonstrate why fallible pragmatic engagement with independently existing reality cannot supply comparable direction, and why reciprocal influence entails ontological inclusion instead of ordinary cognition. Locked score: The strong burden contact and highly responsive idealist explanation justify the recorded strong performance, while slightly overstated warrant, partly unstable terminology, and an underdeveloped inference from direction to terminus constrain its force.

Strongest feature: Folley charitably accepts the anti-reductionist motivation while identifying the decisive comparative problem: metaphysical inquiry needs discriminating admission standards that exclude neither legitimate nonscientific understanding nor intellectual discipline, and his tentative pragmatic maxim appropriately acknowledges uncertainty. Principal limitation: Although the proposal names both dangers, it does not operationalize pragmatic admissibility or explain which consequences distinguish a warranted substantive absolute from an imaginatively permissible construction. Live burden: Folley must specify assessable criteria, show how they adjudicate Bradleyan claims without covert scientism, and establish why normative direction supports only a regulative ideal rather than metaphysical completion. Locked score: The exceptionally direct burden contact, stable framing, explicit qualification, and charitable representation support the recorded very strong performance, while limited evidential development prevents the standard from becoming a decisive refutation.
